html:
The Monaco Grand Prix is a motor race through the narrow streets of Monte Carlo, first run on 14 April 1929. It is the most famous race of Formula One.

The circuit winds past the casino, through a tunnel and around the harbour. It is slow and has almost no room to overtake, which makes qualifying decisive and mistakes costly. It has been part of the Formula One world championship most years since 1950.

With the Indianapolis 500 and the Le Mans 24 Hours it forms the Triple Crown of motorsport. The race gives Monaco its widest audience each year and adds to its image of glamour.
